modules.module_title: Conduct appropriate checks and take necessary measurements

pcs.pc_description: interpret the sketches and work methodology relevant to facade installation
select the appropriate type of panel material and frames and the method of fixing them
check the panels are of specified material and type and as per the given specifications
select the appropriate tools and equipment and check them before use to determine their usability
examine the glass panels for surface and edge defects
